name: Maker's Mark
summary: Maker attribution with required visible identity, optional canonical profile Link, and optional target-owned stamp, studio context, and formatted year wording.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive generic maker-attribution group rendered only with a non-empty visible artist value.

anatomy.name: stamp
anatomy.description: Optional bounded wrapper for target-owned passive stamp image, graphic, mark, or text composition.

anatomy.name: artist
anatomy.description: Required non-empty visible artist, maker, collective, or target display name.

anatomy.name: artistLink
anatomy.description: Optional native canonical Link on the complete visible maker identity when a real target-owned profile destination exists.

anatomy.name: year
anatomy.description: Optional complete target-formatted year wording without automatic parsing or provenance meaning.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Compact bounded attribution surface with intrinsic narrow response.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive identity content with no hover, focus, selection, verification, or live state.

states.name: linked
states.description: Optional canonical Link navigation on the visible identity; the root, stamp, studio and year remain passive.

behavior.name: requiredIdentityOmission
behavior.description: Trim the required artist value and omit the complete root when it is empty; optional parts never keep an invalid shell alive.

behavior.name: genericContainerBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral Web defaults to a generic non-landmark container. Targets may choose aside, article, section, address, or another semantic element only when host document context independently justifies it.

behavior.name: stampAlternativeOwnership
behavior.description: Targets own stamp markup and alternatives: informative marks expose equivalent text, while marks that duplicate the adjacent visible identity are decorative or hidden. Stamp presentation alone never proves authenticity.

behavior.name: identityOwnership
behavior.description: Targets supply complete localized identity and context strings. The contract does not define artist, studio, vendor, product, year, provenance, or certificate records and does not parse display text.

behavior.name: optionalCanonicalProfileLink
behavior.description: A non-empty target-owned profile href progressively wraps the complete visible identity in one native canonical Link. Missing destination leaves ordinary complete text; R9 owns no scripted navigation, profile loading, mutation, authenticity, or result lifecycle.

behavior.name: intrinsicResponse
behavior.description: Logical geometry, complete wrapping, bounded stamp media, private measure, and component-width stamp alignment preserve source order without a public responsive mode.

properties.name: stamp
properties.description: Optional target-owned passive maker-mark media or graphic with context-appropriate accessibility.

properties.name: artist
properties.description: Required non-empty visible maker, artist, collective, or target display name.

properties.name: href
properties.unsetBehavior: Render the complete visible artist identity as ordinary text with no empty or scripted Link.
properties.description: Optional real target-owned maker-profile destination for the canonical Link on the complete visible identity.

properties.name: year
properties.description: Optional complete target-formatted year wording whose factual meaning remains target-owned.

accessibility: Keep the full maker identity available as visible text and omit the complete component when that required text is empty.
Use a generic non-landmark root by default; add complementary, article, section, address, or other document semantics only when the target context independently requires them.
Do not use cite for a person's or organization's name and do not use address unless the content is actual contact information for its nearest article or body.
Use native image or graphic semantics and an equivalent alternative when the stamp adds information; use an empty alternative or aria-hidden when it duplicates the adjacent visible identity.
Do not encode maker identity only in the visual stamp, generate an accessible name from initials, or announce the same identity twice.

Do not present the mark, border, year, icon, code, badge, or visual treatment as proof of authenticity, verification, certification, authorship, manufacture, or provenance without a separately owned substantiated target record.

Keep the root, stamp, studio, and year out of the tab order. When a real profile destination exists, use one native canonical Link on the complete visible identity and preserve its focus, Enter, modified activation, history, forced-color, and reduced-motion behavior.
Omit the Link completely when href is blank; do not synthesize a click handler, empty href, whole-surface activation, profile loading state, or authenticity meaning.
Preserve complete localized strings, automatic direction, text resizing, user text spacing, forced colors, and meaningful source order without truncation.

web.notes: Generic attribution markup, strict required-identity omission, optional native canonical profile Link, contextual stamp semantics, complete text wrapping, and intrinsic logical CSS are implemented without R9-owned JavaScript.

shopify.notes: Select an approved maker source and product relationship before mapping product.vendor, metafields, metaobjects, stamp media, localization, editor validation, or authenticity claims.
